summary: FASE 2 frontend UI smoke test: verified frontend compiles (only harmless eslint warnings, no errors), Login page renders, Booking Flow (public) navigates through all 4 steps without JS errors, and PhoneInput on step 4 works with 246-country selector defaulting to CO (Colombia) and +57 prefix. Protected /manager/dashboard correctly redirects unauthenticated users to /login (confirming ProtectedRoute + ThemeProvider load). Full ThemeToggle/DashboardStats/BookingTools DOM verification requires Google OAuth login which is not automatable (Emergent-managed).
passed: Frontend webpack compiles with only eslint warnings (react-hooks/exhaustive-deps), no errors
Login page loads: 'Nexus by CS2' + 'Iniciar sesión con Google' button visible
Public booking flow /book/org_demo001 loads (200) and shows 4-step stepper
Step 1: services list rendered from GET /api/public/org_demo001/services
Step 2: barbers list rendered and selectable
Step 3: date input + time slots (09:00 etc) rendered after date change
Step 4: PhoneInput fully functional - .PhoneInput wrapper, input[type=tel], select.PhoneInputCountrySelect with 246 country options, defaultCountry=CO, Colombian flag + '+57' prefix visible
Protected route /manager/dashboard redirects unauthenticated users to /login (ProtectedRoute + ThemeProvider working)
Zero JS pageerrors during full booking flow
action_items: Deferred to full testing agent (requires authenticated Google session): verify ThemeToggle button in ManagerDashboard navbar, DashboardStats Recharts (LineChart/PieChart/BarChart) rendering with real /statistics data, BookingTools Copy-link + QR modal + PNG download, localStorage theme persistence.
Optional cleanup: silence 4 react-hooks/exhaustive-deps eslint warnings in DashboardStats.js, BookingFlow.js, ManagerDashboard.js (non-blocking).

notes.auth_limitation: Google OAuth (Emergent-managed) cannot be automated in Playwright; ManagerDashboard-scoped components (ThemeToggle, DashboardStats, BookingTools) confirmed to import/compile cleanly but their in-app rendering requires manual/authenticated verification.
